This is 'B has a uniformly bounded left inverse B^ℓ', with ‖B^ℓ‖ ≤ 1 + H.

theorem FrameData.norm_le_ambient {Q : Type} (d : FrameData Q) (z : Q × ℝ) (w : State)
    {H : ℝ} (hne : d.eigenvector z ≠ 0) (hh : |1 / d.eigenvector z| ≤ H) :
    ‖w‖ ≤ (1 + H) * ‖d.ambient z w‖
